rows.meaning: next to; at the side of
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical location next to something.

example.english: We ate breakfast beside the convenience store.
example.traditional: 我哋坐喺便利店隔籬食早餐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zo6 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 gaak3 lei4 sik6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this when “beside” means in addition to A.

example.english: Beside inviting Ming, I also invited Cheung.
example.traditional: 除咗阿明之外，我仲邀請咗阿強。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 aa3 ming4 zi1 ngoi6 ngo5 zung6 jiu1 cing2 zo2 aa3 koeng4

rows.note: Use this when “beside” means irrelevant to a topic, subject, or point.

example.english: This matter is beside the point you raised.
example.traditional: 呢件事同你講嘅重點冇關。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 tung4 nei5 gong2 ge3 zung6 dim2 mou5 gwaan1
